- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hokkaido's climate and natural environment have influenced its unique cuisine due to its colder climate and abundant natural resources.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-try dishes in Hokkaido include "Genghis Khan Yaki," "Kaisendon," "Jingisukan," "Uni ikura don," and "Ishikari Nabe."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Genghis Khan Yaki" is a local style of grilled lamb or mutton served with vegetables and a savory sauce.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Kaisendon" is a bowl of rice topped with various types of fresh sashimi, including salmon, tuna, and squid.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Jingisukan" is a Japanese version of Mongolian barbecue featuring grilled lamb or mutton seasoned with soy sauce and spices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hokkaido produces high-quality dairy products, including milk, butter, cheese, and ice cream, with local flavors like lavender, melon, and cheese.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Seafood is essential in Hokkaido's cuisine, with dishes like "Uni ikura don" and "Ishikari Nabe" being highlighted.
